desc: Demon lord: dark violet armor, three layers of huge bat wings per side with red crystal ribs, curved gold-tipped horns, long cape, red crystal chest gem, gold spiked shoulder pieces, long tail. Chibi 16-bit pixel art character sprite, big head, small body, right-facing 3/4, 1px navy outline, 2-3 flat shades, no gradients, no noise, no glow, no halo, no shadow. Black void face with small eyes. Palette lavender, white, violet, gold.
